verdict.rationale: Zulip is a team chat product, so in-product AI insights such as summaries or suggestions are a fair axis. However, the evidence pack documents no first-party AI-generated insights or suggestions. The interactive bot framework and API are only developer building blocks for constructing such a capability, and keyword search filters are not AI insights, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
